context.en: This nineteenth- to early twentieth-century portrait presents Xiang Yu as a forceful character. The Julu narrative follows the much earlier Shiji account.
context.zh: 这幅19世纪至20世纪初的项羽像着力表现人物气势；巨鹿故事则依据更早的《史记》叙述。

context.en: The later portrait singles out Xiang Yu, the commander of the counterattack, rather than reconstructing the battlefield.
context.zh: 后世画像突出反攻指挥者项羽这一人物，而非重建战场。

context.en: The portrait names Xiang Yu, one party to the pact. Its late date makes it a study of his remembered image, while the text supplies the negotiations.
context.zh: 画像标识议和一方项羽。其较晚年代使它成为观察人物后世形象的材料，谈判过程则见文字记载。

context.en: Compare the late portrait’s assertive face with the Shiji’s account of retreat and defeat. Both shape how Xiang Yu is remembered, in different media and periods.
context.zh: 可将后世画像中强烈的面部神态，与《史记》中的退却和败亡叙述并读。两者以不同时代的媒介塑造项羽的记忆。

context.en: Han Xin is the figure at left in this later album; Xiao He is at right. The pairing recalls the adviser’s rise, not a scene on the Chencang route.
context.zh: 后世像册左页为韩信、右页为萧何。并置的人物让读者联想到韩信获荐与受用，并非陈仓进军场景。

context.en: The left-hand figure is Han Xin, named on the album leaf. Xiao He at right belongs to the album pairing, not to the Jingxing battlefield account.
context.zh: 左页题名韩信。右页萧何属于像册中的人物并置，并非井陉战场叙事中的参战者。
